constitution: Article XII · Mandatory Rule 1: --version/--help p95 <150ms warm / <300ms cold. Rule 2: no perf claim without a budget and a regression gate.
waiverPolicy: Any budget exceeded by a change requires a ratified waiver (docs/perf/WAIVERS.md) before merge; the regression gate fails CI otherwise.

measurement.samples: >=9 for gate runs, >=21 for baseline artifacts (cold samples use a fresh isolated XR_HOME; warm scenarios discard a warm-up sample; the single largest sample is trimmed when samples >= 15)
measurement.metric: p95 wall-clock process duration on the CI host
measurement.note: Budgets are absolute ceilings for the p95 metric (Constitution Article XII — the binding contract). doctor gate ceiling 1500ms (measured 315-474ms; spec target <1000ms met by measurement on the reference host) — the ceiling accommodates degraded shared runners. The regression band (10%) is evaluated against a SAME-HOST baseline cache (~/.cache/xr, persisted in CI via actions/cache): it blocks only when a same-host baseline exists (run 2+ on any host); otherwise it warns (run 1 seeds the cache). retrieval-100k budget 250ms (measured 25-42ms).
